description: Store an already encrypted AES-256-GCM envelope for at most 24 hours. Encrypt locally first. Never send plaintext or the decryption key to MCP, chat or this API. MCP clients may log tool arguments and bearer tokens. Returns separate read and receipt tokens once. Maximum plaintext size before encryption is 16384 bytes. Creation allows 100 per IP per UTC day; not idempotent. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded base64url ciphertext including the 16-byte authentication tag, no key.

nonce.description: Unpadded base64url of the fresh 12-byte nonce.

name: create_one_time_secret
title: Store a client-encrypted one-time secret
